_about: SISO UI v0.1 candidates, grouped by decision. kind=demo renders live from source (factory/render/demos/<id>.tsx); kind=bundle is 21st's own build of the component (siso-ui-base registry/21st/harvest/<id>/bundle.html); kind=missing is a pick we cannot show yet, with the reason. 'n' is the row in catalogue/curated/picks.jsonl, so his words come from there verbatim.

sections.quote: the side nav at the halo one with the four buttons and the search, their search with the pop-ups, really cool ... I would just want to redesign that comp so it's nicer and then the compress is good back arrows is good

sections.title: 6 · Charts
sections.quote: mini charts, exactly what we needed ... more charts, fucking beautiful, exactly what we wanted
sections.finding: Finding: the bank's saved source for these three is not the chart. area-charts-1's code.tsx is 21st's 17-line placeholder counter, and line-charts-1 and chart are copies of shadcn's chart.tsx wrapper, which draws nothing. The real charts are in each one's demo.tsx, on ReUI's primitives. The previews below are 21st's own builds, so they are the real charts; installing one means taking its demo.tsx, not its code.tsx.
